about: Sound hunt (owner, 2026-10-29: 'In the homework make them find more music also'; Claude owns the ambient and depth upgrade the same day). Two jobs per theme: (1) recorded music the theme still lacks, (2) five field recordings for the theme's own room (the secondary space where you experience the theme away from the collection). Every find is a real microphone recording with a licence stated on its own page. Answers go in one file per session: sound_{agent}_{YYYYMMDD-HHMM}.json in Drive Titan Reliquary/sound-incoming (AI music + field recording finds)/. Rules and file shape: docs/agents/SOUND_HUNT.md.

themes.music_hint: a real kora player (any traditional West African piece) or another Sahel instrument (ngoni, balafon, Tuareg guitar) with a clear licence

moodist_replace.about: Every ambience sound in the app today is an excerpt from the Moodist pack, whose licence is 'CC0 or Pixabay' with no per-file record (audio/ambience/CREDITS.md). Find a replacement of the same kind for each, with a licence on its own page.
